name: Green Gram Thoran
steps: Boil the green gram (moong) until soft but not mushy and drain.
Crush grated coconut with green chili and a little turmeric.
Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves, add the cooked gram and coconut mix, and stir-fry a few minutes.

name: Beetroot Pachadi
steps: Cook grated beetroot until soft.
Grind grated coconut with green chili and mustard, mix in the beetroot, then fold in whisked curd (yogurt).
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Sambar
steps: Pressure-cook the toor dal (pigeon pea) until soft.
Simmer mixed vegetables and drumstick (muringakka) with tamarind and sambar powder, then add the mashed dal.
Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.

name: Moru Curry
steps: Grind grated coconut with green chili, cumin and turmeric, and whisk into the buttermilk (moru).
Heat gently on low without boiling.
Temper with mustard seeds, fenugreek and curry leaves.

name: Avial
steps: Cook mixed vegetables with turmeric until just tender.
Add coarsely ground grated coconut with cumin and green chili, and raw mango (manga) for tang.
Finish with raw coconut oil and curry leaves off the heat.

name: Parippu
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric until soft and mash lightly.
Add a ground paste of grated coconut, cumin and green chili and simmer.
Temper with mustard seeds, dried red chili and curry leaves in ghee.

name: Vendakka Mezhukkupuratti
steps: Chop okra (vendakka) and sauté in coconut oil until the stickiness goes.
Add sliced shallots, crushed red chili and turmeric.
Stir-fry on medium until dry and lightly crisp, finishing with curry leaves.

name: Puttu
steps: Moisten rice flour with salted water to a crumbly texture.
Layer with grated coconut in a puttu mould.
Steam until cooked through and fluffy.

name: Idiyappam
steps: Knead rice flour with hot salted water into a soft dough.
Press through an idiyappam mould onto idli plates and sprinkle grated coconut.
Steam until set and soft.

name: Egg Roast
steps: Boil and halve the eggs.
Sauté sliced onion with ginger, green chili and tomato into a thick masala with chili powder and garam masala.
Coat the eggs in the masala and finish with curry leaves.

name: Dosa
steps: Use fermented rice-and-urad-dal batter at pouring consistency.
Spread thin on a hot greased griddle.
Cook until golden and crisp, then fold and serve.
note: Batter is made from scratch and ferments the day before - not a same-day quick dish.

name: Idli
steps: Pour fermented idli batter into greased idli moulds.
Steam for about 10 minutes until spongy.
Cool slightly and unmould.
note: Batter is made from scratch and ferments the day before - not a same-day quick dish.

name: Upma
steps: Dry-roast the semolina (rava) until fragrant.
Splutter mustard seeds, sauté onion, green chili and curry leaves, then add hot water.
Stir in the rava and cook until it thickens and fluffs up.

name: Oats Upma
steps: Lightly roast the oats.
Splutter mustard seeds, sauté onion, carrot, green chili and curry leaves.
Add a little water and the oats, and cook briefly until soft and dry.

name: Fish Curry
steps: Soak kudampuli (kokum) in warm water.
Cook a masala of chili powder, turmeric and ground coconut with shallots and curry leaves.
Add the fish and kudampuli water and simmer gently until done.

name: Appam
steps: Use fermented rice-and-coconut batter with a little sugar and yeast.
Pour into a hot appam pan and swirl to form thin lacy edges.
Cover and cook until the center is soft and the rim is crisp.
note: Batter is made from scratch and ferments the day before - not a same-day quick dish.

name: Mushroom Curry
steps: Sauté onion and tomato with ginger-garlic and spices.
Add roasted ground coconut or coconut milk and the mushrooms.
Simmer until the mushrooms are cooked and the gravy thickens.

name: Cabbage Thoran
steps: Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add finely shredded cabbage with turmeric and a coconut-green chili mix.
Cover and cook briefly until just tender, keeping it dry.

name: Beans Thoran
steps: Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add finely chopped beans with turmeric and crushed coconut with green chili.
Cover and cook until tender but still bright.

name: Carrot Thoran
steps: Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add grated carrot with turmeric and a coconut-green chili mix.
Cook a few minutes until just soft, keeping it dry.

name: Pumpkin Erisheri
steps: Cook the red cowpea (vanpayar) until soft.
Cook pumpkin (mathanga) with turmeric and mash lightly, then add ground coconut with cumin.
Finish with roasted coconut and curry-leaf tempering in coconut oil.

name: Rasam
steps: Simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, rasam powder and turmeric.
Add crushed garlic and let it froth without boiling hard.
Finish with a mustard, cumin and curry-leaf tempering.

name: Mango Drumstick Curry
steps: Cook drumstick (muringakka) and raw mango (manga) pieces with turmeric and green chili.
Add a ground paste of grated coconut and cumin and simmer.
Temper with mustard seeds, dried red chili and curry leaves.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Sauté onion with ginger garlic until golden, then add tomato and spices.
Add the chicken and coat well in the masala.
Add water, cover, and simmer until tender, finishing with curry leaves.

name: Vendakka Mappas
steps: Lightly fry okra (vendakka) to reduce stickiness.
Sauté onion, green chili and spices, add thin coconut milk and the okra, and simmer.
Finish with thick coconut milk and curry leaves without boiling hard.

name: Fish Fry
steps: Marinate fish in chili powder, turmeric, ginger garlic and salt.
Rest for 15 minutes.
Shallow-fry on both sides until crisp, tossing in curry leaves at the end.

name: Grilled Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon, garlic, pepper and herbs.
Rest for at least 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-grill until cooked through with a charred exterior.

name: Smoothie
steps: Blend banana, milk, oats and pitted dates until smooth.
Add chia seeds, flax seeds, almonds and a pinch of cinnamon and blend again.
Serve chilled, thinning with a little more milk if needed.

name: Chapati Rolls with Healthy Filling
steps: Sauté mixed vegetables, paneer and onion with light spices.
Lay the filling along a warm chapati with some lettuce.
Roll up tightly and slice, or wrap for a tiffin.

name: Boiled Channa
steps: Boil soaked chickpeas till soft.
Toss with chopped onion, tomato, chili, coriander and lemon.

name: Methi Paratha
steps: Knead whole wheat flour with chopped fenugreek leaves (methi), green chili and spices into a soft dough.
Roll out into parathas.
Cook on a tawa with a little oil until browned on both sides.

name: Drumstick Leaf Paratha
steps: Knead whole wheat flour with chopped drumstick leaves (muringa ila), green chili and spices into a soft dough.
Roll out into parathas.
Cook on a tawa with a little oil until browned on both sides.

name: Multigrain Dosa
steps: Use fermented multigrain-and-urad-dal batter at pouring consistency.
Spread thin on a hot greased griddle.
Cook until crisp and golden.
note: Batter is made from scratch and ferments the day before - not a same-day quick dish.

name: Tomato Chutney
steps: Sauté shallots, red chili and tomato until soft.
Cool and grind to a coarse chutney with salt.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Boiled Moong Dal
steps: Boil the green gram (moong) with turmeric until soft.
Season with green chili, salt and a drizzle of coconut oil.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Puri
steps: Knead whole wheat flour with salt and water into a firm dough.
Roll into small discs.
Deep-fry until they puff up and turn golden.

name: Plain Rice
steps: Rinse the rice.
Boil in plenty of water until soft, then drain any excess.

name: Chapati
steps: Knead whole wheat flour with a little oil, salt and water into a soft dough.
Roll into thin rounds.
Cook on a hot tawa until brown spots appear on both sides.

name: Wheat Bread
steps: Serve slices of whole wheat bread as-is or lightly toasted.
Pair with a curry or side.

name: Mixed Salad
steps: Wash and chop whichever raw vegetables are in the house.
Toss together with a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
note: A rotating raw mix - the combination varies each time.

name: Boiled Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for about 8-10 minutes.
Cool, peel and halve.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to serve.

name: Egg Curry
steps: Boil the eggs and set aside.
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic and tomato with spices, then add coconut milk and simmer.
Add the halved eggs and finish with curry leaves.

name: Kadala Curry
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked black chickpeas (kadala) until soft.
Add a roasted coconut masala with onion and spices, and simmer.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil.

name: Prawn Curry
steps: Clean the prawns and soak kudampuli (kokum) in warm water.
Cook a coconut-chili masala with shallots and curry leaves.
Add the prawns and kudampuli water and simmer just until done.

name: Vegetable Stew
steps: Simmer mixed vegetables with onion, green chili and whole spices in thin coconut milk.
Once tender, add thick coconut milk and warm through without boiling.
Finish with curry leaves and a little coconut oil.

name: Puli Inji
steps: Fry finely chopped ginger (inji) and green chili until fragrant.
Add tamarind extract and jaggery and simmer to a thick relish.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Chicken Roast
steps: Marinate and sear the chicken, then set aside.
Cook a thick onion-tomato masala with ginger garlic and spices.
Return the chicken and roast on medium until dark and semi-dry.

name: Pazham Pori
steps: Slice the ripe plantain (pazham) lengthwise.
Dip in a batter of maida, a pinch of turmeric and sugar.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.

name: Kappa
steps: Boil peeled tapioca (kappa) with turmeric and salt until soft, then drain.
Crush grated coconut with green chili, cumin and shallots.
Mix through the tapioca and finish with a curry-leaf tempering.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Make a smooth tomato-onion-cashew gravy and cook with butter and spices.
Add cream and a little sugar to balance.
Fold in paneer cubes and simmer briefly.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure-cook the toor dal (pigeon pea) with turmeric until soft.
Simmer with sautéed onion and tomato.
Pour over a hot tempering of garlic, cumin, dried red chili and ghee.

name: Rajma
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked kidney beans (rajma) until soft.
Cook a thick onion-tomato masala with ginger garlic and spices.
Add the beans with their stock and simmer until the gravy thickens.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked chickpeas (channa) until soft.
Cook an onion-tomato masala with ginger garlic and spices.
Add the chickpeas and simmer, finishing with a little chaat masala.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Mash cooked rice and mix with curd (yogurt) and salt.
Temper mustard seeds, green chili, ginger and curry leaves and stir through.
Garnish with fresh pomegranate and serve cool.

name: Coconut Chutney
steps: Grind grated coconut with green chili, ginger and a little roasted gram.
Loosen with water to a smooth chutney and salt.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Mutton Biryani
steps: Marinate mutton in curd (yogurt) and biryani masala, then cook into a thick masala with fried onion until tender.
Parboil the basmati rice separately.
Layer rice over the mutton, dum on low heat until fragrant, and fluff.

name: Kanji
steps: Cook the rice with plenty of water to a soft porridge and season with salt.
Cook the green gram (moong) separately until soft.
Serve the kanji with the green gram and grated coconut on the side.

name: Vazhakumbu Thoran
steps: Clean and finely chop the banana flower (vazhakumbu) and cook with turmeric until soft.
Add crushed grated coconut with green chili.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves and stir-fry until dry.

name: Chia Seeds Pudding
steps: Soak the chia seeds in milk overnight, or at least 2 hours.
Top with chopped apple, pomegranate and dates before serving.

name: Beetroot Thoran
steps: Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add grated beetroot with turmeric and a coconut-green chili mix.
Cover and cook until tender, keeping it dry.

name: Beetroot Mezhukkupuratti
steps: Cut beetroot into thin batons.
Sauté in coconut oil with shallots, crushed red chili and turmeric.
Stir-fry on medium until tender and dry.

name: Vegetable Pulav
steps: Sauté whole spices and onion in ghee until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and soaked basmati rice with water.
Cook until fluffy and the grains stay separate.

name: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil and mash mixed vegetables and potato.
Cook with onion, tomato, butter and pav bhaji masala into a thick mash.
Serve hot with buttered toasted pav.

name: Godambu Dosa with Coconut Filling
steps: Make a thin pouring batter from whole wheat flour and a pinch of salt.
Cook coconut with melted jaggery and cardamom into a sweet filling.
Cook thin dosas, spoon in the coconut filling, and fold over.

name: Padavalanga Thoran
steps: Chop the snake gourd (padavalanga) finely and cook with turmeric until soft.
Add crushed grated coconut with green chili.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves and stir-fry until dry.

name: Pongal
steps: Cook the rice and green gram (moong) together to a soft mush.
Temper pepper, cumin, ginger and cashew in ghee.
Mix the tempering through and serve warm.

name: Lemon Rice
steps: Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, green chili, curry leaves and turmeric.
Toss through cooked rice.
Stir in lemon juice and salt off the heat.

name: Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta until al dente and drain.
Cook a tomato-garlic sauce with onion and herbs.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and finish with cheese.

name: Qubus
steps: Shop-bought flatbread - warm briefly before serving.
note: Store-bought. The bread served with grilled chicken.

name: Hummus
steps: Shop-bought - spoon into a bowl and serve.

name: Garlic Paste
steps: Shop-bought - spoon into a bowl and serve.
note: Store-bought. Alternative to hummus with grilled chicken.

name: Banana
steps: Serve fresh alongside the breakfast.
note: Store-bought. The pairing for Puttu and Upma.

name: Plain Curd
steps: Whisk the curd lightly with a pinch of salt.
Serve cold alongside the parathas.
note: The only thing served with methi or drumstick leaf paratha - no curry.

name: Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with chopped onion, green chili and coriander.
Pour into a hot pan and cook both sides till set.

name: Boiled Lentils
steps: Boil the lentils with a little turmeric and salt till soft.
Drain and serve warm as a protein side.

name: Fruit Bowl
steps: Chop whatever fruit is in the house and serve.

name: Sundal
steps: Boil the soaked chickpeas till soft and drain.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and chili, then toss with coconut.

name: Tea and Biscuits
steps: Brew the tea and serve with a couple of biscuits.
